   - Each child is of a different age.
   - There is a difference of two years between any two consecutive children.

   - If we let the age of the youngest child be \( x \), then the ages of the five children will be \( x, x+2, x+4, x+6, \) and \( x+8 \) (since there is a difference of 2 years between consecutive children).
